_comment: Syntax colours raised to meet WCAG contrast against the editor background, computed by tools/suggest-contrast.mjs. Each is the smallest hue-preserving move that clears its floor: 4.5 for code, 3.0 for comments, which are meant to recede. Applied to tokenColors only — the same hex often appears in the workbench colours too, where it sits on a different background and is fine. Re-run tools/contrast.mjs after any change here.
